name: tabs
useFor: Use line tabs to switch between views of one thing (Parcel, Power, Water, Terrain on a site). Use variant="segmented" for two to four short choices that change how the same data is shown (Map, List, Compare); pass full to share the width. Labels are words, one or two each.
constraints: A mark that animates on first paint or on resize
source: Not in Figma: built from the system's 1px lines and the rail's Mist current row, for a designer's review
title: Tabs
description: Line tabs on a 1px Mist rule with a 1px Forest line under the selected one, and segmented tabs in a Stone-lined Bone track with the selected tab on Mist.
